title: Cohomology of a finite coproduct is the product of component cohomologies
statement: Let $C=\coprod_{i\in I}C_i$ be a finite coproduct of schemes [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family] with each inclusion $C_i\hookrightarrow C$ open and closed. For an abelian etale sheaf $F$ on $C_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], the canonical restriction maps identify $H^q(C,F)$ with the finite product $\prod_{i\in I}H^q(C_i,F|_{C_i})$ for every $q\ge 0$, where $F|_{C_i}=\iota_i^{-1}F$ is the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] along the inclusion $\iota_i:C_i\hookrightarrow C$.
